Show adding and taking away with objects, fingers, drawings, sounds, acting out or equations.

state_code: # SOURCES (Colorado Academic Standards: Mathematics, adopted 2018 = "2020 CAS", in classrooms from 2020-21; IN EFFECT FOR K-5 IN 2026-27)
# - Standards page: https://ed.cde.state.co.us/comath/statestandards (checked 2026-10-01; lists only the 2020 standards, adopted 2018)
# - Version in effect: review page https://ed.cde.state.co.us/fs/pages/2769 and math revisions page https://ed.cde.state.co.us/fs/pages/2779 say the
#   State Board (Dec 2024) chose to revise only the HIGH SCHOOL math standards; those were adopted May 14, 2026 and replace only the HS portion
#   (CDE plans a two-year adoption support plan). No K-8 math revision exists, so K-5 stays on the 2018-adopted standards for 2026-27.
# - Colorado K-5 math (2020 CAS) is organized by CCSS clusters. GLE codes are written MA.<grade>.<domain>.<cluster>, e.g. MA.K.CC.A, MA.3.OA.B
#   (kindergarten uses "K"). Evidence outcomes are numbered with the CCSS standard number (e.g. 3.OA.B has EOs 5 and 6), so state_code here is
#   GLE code + EO number, e.g. MA.3.OA.B.5. CDE does not print this combined string; it prints the GLE code plus the numbered EO.
# - The old 2010-style codes (GR.3-S.1-GLE.2-EO.a) and the MA.<grade>.<std>.<gle>.<letter> pattern are NOT used by the current standards.
# - Every K-5 EO carries an official "(CCSS: x)" tag; ccss column = that tag. One tag lacks the cluster letter (MA.K.CC.B.5 says "K.CC.5") -> K.CC.B.5.
# - Lettered sub-items (a, b, c, d) restate CCSS sub-parts (tagged e.g. CCSS: 3.MD.C.7.a) and are folded into the parent EO.
# STANDARDS AND GLEs (CO standard number -> CCSS domains; MD sits under Standard 3, not 4)
# - 1 Number and Quantity: CC (K), NBT (K-5), NF (3-5)
# - GLEs: K CC.A-C, NBT.A, OA.A, MD.A-B, G.A-B; 1 NBT.A-C, OA.A-D, MD.A-C, G.A; 2 NBT.A-B, OA.A-C, MD.A-D, G.A; 3 NBT.A, NF.A, OA.A-D, MD.A-D, G.A;
#   4 NBT.A-B, NF.A-C, OA.A-C, MD.A-C, G.A; 5 NBT.A-B, NF.A-B, OA.A-B, MD.A-C, G.A-B (all named exactly as the CCSS cluster headings).
# - Mathematical Practices, Colorado Essential Skills, inquiry questions and coherence connections are non-EO supporting text and are skipped.
# CCSS K-5 STANDARDS DROPPED: none. All CCSS K-5 standards appear as Colorado evidence outcomes, one-to-one.
# NOTABLE NON-CCSS CONTENT: none in K-5 evidence outcomes. Wording is CCSS nearly verbatim; small edits only (e.g. "Understand" -> "Describe"/"Explain"
#   in 3.NF.A.1-2, 3.G.A.1, 4.NBT.A.1, 5.G.B.3; "Apply" in K.CC.B.4; "Model" in 5.MD.C.5.a; CCSS footnotes moved inline as parentheticals).
#   Personal financial literacy is NOT in the 2020 math standards (no PFL EOs found in K-5); coins/money appear only via 2.MD.C.8 and 4.MD.A.2.
# - All rows are kind "same": the text differences are rewording, not content changes.
# - state_code format (GLE + CCSS-style EO number) is my construction from how CDE prints GLE codes and EO numbers; CDE has no single combined EO code.
